new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/counter")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Accept", "text/plain")
                ),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withResponseMode(org.mockserver.mock.ResponseMode.SWITCH)
.respond(java.util.Arrays.asList(
        
                response()
                        .withStatusCode(200)
                        .withHeaders(
                                new Header("Date", "Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:00 GMT")
                        )
                        .withBody("one"),
        
                response()
                        .withStatusCode(200)
                        .withHeaders(
                                new Header("Date", "Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:01 GMT")
                        )
                        .withBody("two"),
        
                response()
                        .withStatusCode(200)
                        .withHeaders(
                                new Header("Date", "Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:03 GMT")
                        )
                        .withBody("three")
));


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/health"),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Date", "Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:00 GMT")
                )
                .withBody("ok")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("GET")
                .withPath("/health"),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(200)
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Date", "Mon, 01 Jan 2024 00:00:02 GMT")
                )
                .withBody("ok")
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withMethod("POST")
                .withPath("/counter")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Accept", "text/plain")
                ),
        Times.once(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.respond(
        response()
                .withStatusCode(201)
                .withBody("created")
);
